decisions.reason: SIWE access through the Transak-created wallet is an alternative to the email-code path and does not change the email authentication requirement; the same message already records the email-code access details.
The FAQ requirement already has a message-184 MODIFY that includes SIWE access through the Transak-created wallet, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
The wallet-authentication change does not alter the fiat-mint mechanics, and the candidate's message-184 MODIFY already records Transak wallet provisioning and the mint destination.
Adding SIWE access for the Transak-created wallet does not change transactional email delivery or contents; the email details independently stated in message 184 are already represented.
Wallet SIWE access does not change the PDF.js reader engine or its dashboard and email-linked entry points.
The wallet-authentication modification does not itself change prize payout behavior, and the independent automatic-payout decision from message 184 is already represented under this Requirement.
Authenticated dashboard access through SIWE does not alter the requirement that leaderboards and pool values remain available through unauthenticated public APIs.

The commission already pays automatically to the referrer's wallet; allowing a fiat buyer to access a Transak-created wallet through SIWE does not change the commission amount, trigger, recipient, destination, or timing.

Wallet authentication does not change the NFT token serial's role or persistence as the referral code; confirmation-email details are an independent clause rather than a consequence of the source authentication modification.
SIWE access for a Transak-created wallet does not change which NFT-associated rights, badges, referral identity, or prize tickets follow an NFT transfer.
The source wallet-authentication modification does not require a change to the About-page content; the prize-payout language elsewhere in the same message is a separate product decision.
Adding SIWE access for fiat buyers does not alter badge award thresholds, award basis, or on-chain NFT attachment.
